participation.context: Stood in the yard as the press moved toward the stage.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You were among the penny-standers, with the flag up and the thatch in the winter light.

title: Stood in the Rose yard before the play

participation.context: Stood by the post on the left and followed the yard.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Played, easy, in a part smaller than himself.
participation.name: Edward Alleyn

participation.context: Counted heads at the door with his lips, and did not show the figure.
participation.name: Philip Henslowe

story.body: You stood by a post on the left. The board gave the title only. A tall boy with a staff faced three Spanish swaggerers, and the yard roared. You looked at the yard more than the stage. Henslowe did not show the count.

title: Stood by the post and looked at the yard

story.body: You had the yard in the moment the staff landed, and the three swaggerers under it.

title: Stood by the post as the boy cudgelled three Spanish swaggerers

participation.context: Thanked him briefly and did not ask the takings.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Said he was glad of the visit, and let him go.
participation.name: Edward Alleyn

participation.context: Kept the count at the door.
participation.name: Philip Henslowe

story.body: You spoke to Alleyn for a minute at the door. He was cordial. Henslowe did not give you the count. You left.

title: Heard Alleyn's cordial word and set Henslowe's count aside
